name: hms-guides
description: Generator for the HMS developer guides. Separate from the API and app on purpose — it is documentation tooling, not part of the system.

scripts.all: node guide-01.cjs && node guide-02.cjs && node guide-03.cjs

comment: The `all` script only works for guides whose source file exists here. Guides 01 and 02 were written before this generator, and their .docx files are committed — they do not need regenerating.
